sources.title: HoliAntiSpoof: Audio LLM for Holistic Speech Anti-Spoofing
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce HoliAntiSpoof, the first audio large language model (ALLM) framework for holistic speech anti-spoofing analysis. HoliAntiSpoof reformulates spoofing analysis as a unified text generation task, enabling joint reasoning over spoofing methods, affected speech attributes, and their semantic impacts.

sources.title: GitHub - OpenTSLab/HoliAntiSpoof
sources.snippet: Data and PreTrained Model DailyTalkEdit and the semantic influence annotation of PartialEdit are provided here. The pretrained HoliAntiSpoof (DoRA rank = 64) checkpoint is available here.

sources.title: HoliAntiSpoof: Audio LLM for Holistic Speech Anti-Spoofing
sources.snippet: Abstract HoliAntiSpoof presents the first audio large language model framework for comprehensive speech anti-spoofing analysis that jointly reasons over spoofing methods, speech attributes, and their semantic impacts through text generation.
